title: Tracking your environmental impact
summary: This document explains how often you receive monthly environmental impact reports for Evergreen Account transactions posted in the period, and what they include: total posted Evergreen spend, estimated CO2 offset ($1.25 grams per USD), and estimated trees (1 tree per $1,000). It provides formulas, unit conversions, reconciliation steps, and timing rules (pending excluded; settlement posting dates; refunds/chargebacks as negative adjustments; later corrections show next month).
